maddeler.e:
نلتبس (form VIII)
# نَلْتَبِسُ (naltabisu) /nal.ta.bi.su/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِلْتَبَسَ (iltabasa)
# نُلْتَبَسُ (nultabasu) /nul.ta.ba.su/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَبَسَ (iltabasa)
# نَلْتَبِسَ (naltabisa) /nal.ta.bi.sa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِلْتَبَسَ (iltabasa)
# نُلْتَبَسَ (nultabasa) /nul.ta.ba.sa/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
